# Volume IV: Specialized Fire Protection, Mission-Critical Plumbing, and Life Safety

This volume addresses measurement rules and specifications for double-interlock pre-action sprinklers, clean agent gaseous suppression, high-pressure water mist, VESDA aspiration smoke detection, reverse osmosis (RO) water treatment, and distance-locating leak detection systems.
